facts.text: Tennessee State University is a historically black university in Nashville that merged with the former University of Tennessee at Nashville on July 1, 1979 under a court order.

sources.title: About TSU - Tennessee State University
sources.quote: On July 1, 1979, the case was settled by a court order merging the former University of Tennessee at Nashville with TSU.

sources.title: About TSU - Tennessee State University
sources.quote: TSU's role as one of America's preeminent historically black universities and its emerging status as a comprehensive national university.
